cover_letter.greeting: Dear EY-Parthenon Strategy and Execution Team,
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Deal Management Senior Associate/Consultant role in New York. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I spent about five and a half years at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. I'm drawn to Strategy and Execution because it sits where the analysis meets the plan a client actually has to carry out.

At Lenovo I built forecast models and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and ran variance and sensitivity analyses on budget reallocation. At JPMorgan I built models on $10M of marketing-channel budget and benchmarked past allocations, which pointed to 30% efficiency gains. In my MBA I valued J.M. Smucker with comps, a DCF checked against a sell-side model, and an LBO.
My deal modeling so far comes from MBA coursework, so I'd bring modeling, scenario work and clear executive materials, and learn the deal process from your team. I'd welcome the chance to talk.

outreach: Hi [Name], I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli applying for the Deal Management Sr Associate role in EY-Parthenon Strategy and Execution.
